The threat is especially serious for AI agents with tool or terminal access. A triggered model could quietly download and run attacker code,…

items.title: Formally verifying agent-written full-stack web apps with PDD Kit
items.summary: AI agents can generate code at a scale that’s hard for humans to review line-by-line. PDD Kit helps ensure the code is doing what the developer intended by creating formal specifications and testing against them. It converts developer intent into a Verus specification, proves AI-generated code meets it for every input, and uses tests where proofs aren't…
